correctness.rationale: On any outward rooted tree, ≤1 child makes Δ vacuously true, so an adjacent pair of branching vertices is exactly the obstruction; the converse valuation uses the disjoint child sets to make Δp true at the parent but ΔΔp false. The labelled set decomposition A=z(1+T), B=z(exp(A)−1−A) proves the unique functional equation and recurrence. Positive aperiodic implicit-function singularity transfer gives the exact limiting ratio. The attached standalone checker constructs all Prüfer-labelled rooted trees through 7 vertices, directly checks all valuations through 6, and matches the recurrence; finite checks are supporting evidence, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The axiom Δp→ΔΔp formalizes an epistemic introspection principle in current noncontingency logic. The finding gives an exact structural frame boundary and a complete labelled census of all finite rooted trees satisfying it, showing a sharp first failure at n=5 and exponential rarity under Cayley’s model. This is a natural completeness/enumeration question, not an arbitrary isolated test or routine parameter increment.
